import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    if len(feats.ids) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Check for near-duplicates
    corr_pairs = []
    for i in range(len(feats.ids)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(feats.ids)):
            r, _ = stats.pearsonr(feats.x[:,i], feats.x[:,j])
            if abs(r) >= 0.6:
                corr_pairs.append((feats.ids[i], feats.ids[j]))
    
    # Build set of unique features (remove near-duplicates)
    unique_features = set(feats.ids)
    for a, b in corr_pairs:
        if a in unique_features and b in unique_features:
            # Remove one of the pair (keep the one with lower p-value)
            unique_features.remove(b)
    
    # Compute effect sizes and p-values for each feature
    effects = []
    for fid in unique_features:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, idx]
        y = feats.y
        
        # Effect size: mean difference between groups
        mean_y1 = np.mean(x[y==1])
        mean_y0 = np.mean(x[y==0])
        effect_size = mean_y1 - mean_y0
        
        # Welch's t-test
        group0 = x[y==0]
        group1 = x[y==1]
        if len(group0) > 1 and len(group1) > 1:
            t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(group0, group1, equal_var=False)
        else:
            p_val = 1.0
            
        effects.append((fid, effect_size, p_val))
    
    # Sort by effect size (largest first)
    effects.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x[1]), reverse=True)
    
    # For each stratum, check whether effect is significant
    strata_effects = defaultdict(list)
    for stratum in set(feats.stratum):
        mask = [s == stratum for s in feats.stratum]
        strata_x = feats.x[mask]
        strata_y = feats.y[mask]
        
        for fid, _, _ in effects[:10]:  # Top 10 for speed
            idx = feats.column(fid)
            x = strata_x[:, idx]
            y = strata_y
            
            if len(np.unique(y)) < 2:
                continue
                
            try:
                t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==0], x[y==1], equal_var=False)
                strata_effects[fid].append(p_val)
            except:
                pass
    
    # Select features that are significant in all strata
    valid_drivers = []
    for fid, _, _ in effects:
        p_vals = strata_effects.get(fid, [])
        if len(p_vals) > 0 and all(p <= 0.05 for p in p_vals):
            valid_drivers.append(fid)
    
    # If no valid drivers, return empty design
    if not valid_drivers:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Use top 4 valid drivers as drivers (max 4 to satisfy constraint)
    drivers = tuple(valid_drivers[:4])
    
    # Select columns to include in model - use only drivers for simplicity
    columns = drivers
    
    # No interaction terms to keep model small
    products = ()
    
    # Simple weighted score: sum of standardized features with weights based on effect sizes
    loadings = {}
    for fid in drivers:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, idx]
        y = feats.y
        # Weight by absolute effect size
        mean_y1 = np.mean(x[y==1])
        mean_y0 = np.mean(x[y==0])
        effect = mean_y1 - mean_y0
        loadings[fid] = abs(effect)
    
    # Normalize loadings
    total = sum(loadings.values())
    if total > 0:
        for k in loadings:
            loadings[k] /= total
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
